title: Blue Demon Emerging
description: A muscular blue demon with large curved horns and glowing eyes emerges from a crumbling stone archway on a European cobblestone street. In the dramatic sky above, a massive glowing magical sigil with concentric circles and runes hovers amid fiery orange clouds and streaking meteors, overlooking a city with a domed cathedral in the distance.
prompt: A muscular blue demon with large curved horns, glowing white eyes and sharp claws emerges from an ancient stone archway covered in ivy, reaching forward with one hand. He stands on a wet cobblestone street lined with European buildings and outdoor cafes. In the sky above Paris, a giant intricate glowing magical sigil with concentric golden circles and runes floats among fiery orange and purple clouds with shooting stars and a distant cathedral visible, dramatic fantasy scene
